export { default as BubbleMenu } from "./bubble-menu.vue";
export { CODE_BLOCK_LANGUAGES, getLanguageLabel } from "./utils";

export const CODE_BLOCK_LANGUAGES = [
  "javascript",
  "typescript",
  "html",
  "css",
  "json",
  "python",
  "rust",
  "go",
  "java",
  "c",
  "cpp",
  "ruby",
  "php",
  "swift",
  "kotlin",
  "sql",
  "bash",
  "markdown",
  "yaml",
  "xml",
  "plaintext",
] as const;

export const CODE_BLOCK_LANGUAGE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  bash: "Bash",
  c: "C",
  cpp: "C++",
  css: "CSS",
  go: "Go",
  html: "HTML",
  java: "Java",
  javascript: "JavaScript",
  json: "JSON",
  kotlin: "Kotlin",
  markdown: "Markdown",
  php: "PHP",
  plaintext: "Plain Text",
  python: "Python",
  ruby: "Ruby",
  rust: "Rust",
  sql: "SQL",
  swift: "Swift",
  typescript: "TypeScript",
  xml: "XML",
  yaml: "YAML",
};

export const getLanguageLabel = (lang: string): string =>
  CODE_BLOCK_LANGUAGE_LABELS[lang] ?? lang;

import {
  Bold,
  Code,
  Heading1,
  Heading2,
  Heading3,
  Heading4,
  Heading5,
  Heading6,
  Highlighter,
  Italic,
  Link,
  Link2Off,
  List,
  ListOrdered,
  ListTodo,
  Minus,
  Redo2,
  RemoveFormatting,
  SquareCode,
  Strikethrough,
  Subscript,
  Superscript,
  TextAlignCenter,
  TextAlignEnd,
  TextAlignJustify,
  TextAlignStart,
  TextQuote,
  Underline,
  Undo2,
} from "@lucide/vue";

import type { RichTextEditorIcons } from "./icon-types";
import { DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_ICONS } from "./language-icons";

export const DEFAULT_ICONS: RichTextEditorIcons = {
  alignCenterControlIcon: TextAlignCenter,
  alignJustifyControlIcon: TextAlignJustify,
  alignLeftControlIcon: TextAlignStart,
  alignRightControlIcon: TextAlignEnd,
  blockquoteControlIcon: TextQuote,
  boldControlIcon: Bold,
  bulletListControlIcon: List,
  clearFormattingControlIcon: RemoveFormatting,
  codeBlockControlIcon: SquareCode,
  codeControlIcon: Code,
  h1ControlIcon: Heading1,
  h2ControlIcon: Heading2,
  h3ControlIcon: Heading3,
  h4ControlIcon: Heading4,
  h5ControlIcon: Heading5,
  h6ControlIcon: Heading6,
  highlightControlIcon: Highlighter,
  hrControlIcon: Minus,
  italicControlIcon: Italic,
  languageIcons: DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_ICONS,
  linkControlIcon: Link,
  orderedListControlIcon: ListOrdered,
  redoControlIcon: Redo2,
  strikeControlIcon: Strikethrough,
  subscriptControlIcon: Subscript,
  superscriptControlIcon: Superscript,
  taskListControlIcon: ListTodo,
  underlineControlIcon: Underline,
  undoControlIcon: Undo2,
  unlinkControlIcon: Link2Off,
};

import { defineComponent, h } from "vue";

import { BubbleMenu } from "./bubble-menu";
import {
  AlignCenterControl,
  AlignJustifyControl,
  AlignLeftControl,
  AlignRightControl,
  BlockquoteControl,
  BoldControl,
  BulletListControl,
  ClearFormattingControl,
  CodeBlockControl,
  CodeControl,
  H1Control,
  H2Control,
  H3Control,
  H4Control,
  H5Control,
  H6Control,
  HighlightControl,
  HrControl,
  ItalicControl,
  OrderedListControl,
  RedoControl,
  StrikethroughControl,
  SubscriptControl,
  SuperscriptControl,
  TaskListControl,
  UnderlineControl,
  UndoControl,
  UnlinkControl,
} from "./controls";
import LinkControl from "./link-control.vue";
import Content from "./rte-content.vue";
import ControlsGroup from "./rte-controls-group.vue";
import Footer from "./rte-footer.vue";
import RichTextEditorRoot from "./rte-text-editor.vue";
import Toolbar from "./rte-toolbar.vue";
import RichTextEditorControl from "./ui/rte-control.vue";

export const RichTextEditor = Object.assign(RichTextEditorRoot, {
  AlignCenter: AlignCenterControl,
  AlignJustify: AlignJustifyControl,
  AlignLeft: AlignLeftControl,
  AlignRight: AlignRightControl,
  Blockquote: BlockquoteControl,
  Bold: BoldControl,
  BubbleMenu,
  BulletList: BulletListControl,
  ClearFormatting: ClearFormattingControl,
  Code: CodeControl,
  CodeBlock: CodeBlockControl,
  Content,
  Control: RichTextEditorControl,
  ControlsGroup,
  Footer,
  H1: H1Control,
  H2: H2Control,
  H3: H3Control,
  H4: H4Control,
  H5: H5Control,
  H6: H6Control,
  Highlight: HighlightControl,
  Hr: HrControl,
  Italic: ItalicControl,
  Link: LinkControl,
  OrderedList: OrderedListControl,
  Redo: RedoControl,
  Strikethrough: StrikethroughControl,
  Subscript: SubscriptControl,
  Superscript: SuperscriptControl,
  TaskList: TaskListControl,
  Toolbar,
  Underline: UnderlineControl,
  Undo: UndoControl,
  Unlink: UnlinkControl,
});

export { useRichTextEditorContext } from "./context";
export { useEditorState } from "./composables";
export type {
  RichTextEditorFooterProps,
  RichTextEditorProps,
  RichTextEditorVariant,
  WordCountInfo,
} from "./types";
export type { RichTextEditorLabels } from "./labels";
export { DEFAULT_LABELS } from "./labels";
export type { RichTextEditorIcons } from "./icon-types";
export { DEFAULT_ICONS } from "./icons";
export { DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_ICONS } from "./language-icons";
export { Link, CodeBlock } from "./extensions";
export { createControl } from "./controls";

<script setup lang="ts">
import { cn } from "../utils";
import { toggleVariants } from "./toggle";

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });

withDefaults(defineProps<{ active?: boolean; disabled?: boolean }>(), {
  active: false,
  disabled: false,
});
</script>

<template>
  <button
    v-bind="$attrs"
    type="button"
    data-slot="toggle"
    :data-state="active ? 'on' : 'off'"
    :aria-pressed="active"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :class="cn(toggleVariants({ size: 'sm' }), 'rte-control-button')"
    @mousedown.prevent
  >
    <slot />
  </button>
</template>
